tools.name: book_demo
tools.description: Book a real demo appointment with the SalesMind AI team. This creates a confirmed calendar booking and sends a confirmation email — it is not a draft. Call get_demo_availability first and confirm the exact date, time and email address with the user before calling this.

slotStart.description: Exact appointment start as an ISO-8601 timestamp, taken verbatim from get_demo_availability. Do not invent or round times.

funnel.description: Demo track. Must match the funnel passed to get_demo_availability.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Paris. Defaults to the visitor's detected timezone.

confirmed.description: Must be true. Set this only after the user has explicitly confirmed the exact date, time and their email address. Do not set it on the user's behalf.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Return structured company information for SalesMind AI.

tools.name: get_demo_availability
tools.description: List available demo appointment slots. Returns ISO-8601 timestamps grouped by day, in the visitor's timezone. Call this before book_demo so you can offer the user real times.

funnel.description: Which demo track. 'done-with-you' (default) for most visitors, 'managed' for fully-managed service, 'white-label' for resellers.

daysAhead.description: How many days ahead to search. Defaults to 14, maximum 31.

tools.name: get_pricing_info
tools.description: Return public pricing model summary without exposing numeric pricing.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search blog posts and static website pages by query and optional content type.
